thread:
Maya (PM): Heads-up — consolidating tool-call payloads for v1 launch. Need triage on scope and launch checklist.
Sam (Product): Quick q: do we commit to typed tool schemas + strict result shapes for v1? Customers keep asking.
Toni (Eng): From infra side we can support a JSON-schema-ish shape. Proposal: 'inputs' and 'outputs' top-level, allow nested objects, max depth 3, max args 12. Runtime validation at call-time optional (opt-in).
Alex (Eng): Concern: nested schemas + streaming responses increases complexity a lot. Could we ship a simple 'invoke' surface for structured calls and defer streaming/large payloads to v2?
Maya (PM): Draft launch criteria idea: 1) JS + Python SDK helpers, 2) canonical schema spec + examples, 3) telemetry for schema mismatches + per-tool metrics, 4) canary with 3 pilot customers and rollback policy.
Sam (Product): ElasticCorp specifically needs strict typing for their 'account_balance' tool and example fixtures. They'll only sign up for dedicated if we have schema validation.
Toni (Eng): Implementation pattern that worked elsewhere: include both structured and raw outputs. Example: result.status enum + result.payload (structured) + result.raw (string). That keeps consumer flexibility.
Alex (Eng): Bandwidth estimate: ~3 sprints to do schema parsing + validation + SDK helpers if we limit to JSON Schema draft subset and skip streaming for now.
Maya (PM): Prioritization suggestion: #1 schema shape + telemetry, #2 SDK helpers + examples, #3 streaming variant and large payload optimizations. Agree?
Sam (Product): Agree. Also want to surface tool errors consistently: error.code (machine), error.message (human), and error.hints (optional).
Toni (Eng): Proto snippet I'm going to flesh out:
```
{ "tool": "user_lookup", "args": { "email": "string" }, "meta": { "schema_version": "v1", "timeout_ms": 5000 } }
```
Result shape:
```
{ "status":"success", "payload": { "id":"string","name":"string" }, "raw":"..." }
```

Alex (Eng): Add fallback policy: if validation fails, return result.status='partial' and include validation.errors array + raw output. That helps telemetry + graceful degradation.
Maya (PM): Action items: Toni to draft the canonical schema doc + examples by Fri COB; Alex to scope streaming as separate epic; Sam to line up 3 pilot customers and collect concrete fixtures. I'll put this on the roadmap and add rollout criteria to the PM sync.
deploy-bot: deploy.notice: canary branch created: toolcall-api-prototype (canary-2024-11-03).
Sam (Product): Small ask from support: include per-tool default timeout and an optional cost_estimate field in meta so customers can self-evaluate.
Maya (PM): Noted — we'll include cost_estimate in the meta proposal. Reconfirm Wed 3pm sync. :calendar: 
Toni (Eng): I'll include sample validation error response and telemetry keys (schema_id, mismatch_count, forwarded_raw) in the draft.
Alex (Eng): Also adding a note about KV cache impact when tools call external services — may affect latency SLOs.
Maya (PM): Great. Thanks all.
